publicPricing.title: Pricing
publicPricing.lead: Current prices for rotating residential data and static residential IPs. Sign up to buy. Prices and stock are confirmed again at checkout.
publicPricing.footnote: Prices are in CNY. Data is metered in decimal GB (1 GB = 1,000,000,000 bytes). Rotating and static proxies share one account and wallet.
publicPricing.dynamicHint: Pay by data with packages that never expire. Connect through a SOCKS5 gateway with rotating exits.
publicPricing.dynamicFailed: Could not load rotating proxy packages
publicPricing.dynamicClosed: Rotating proxy packages are not on sale yet. Prices will appear here when sales open.
publicPricing.noPackages: No rotating proxy packages are on sale right now.
publicPricing.exclusiveHint: Each dedicated IP is assigned to one customer. Prices vary by region and lease term.
publicPricing.sharedHint: Several customers may share each IP. Choose an intended use to see the prices and stock for that use.
publicPricing.staticFailed: Could not load static IP prices
publicPricing.exclusiveClosed: Dedicated static IPs are not on sale yet. Prices will appear here when sales open.
publicPricing.sharedClosed: Shared static IPs are not on sale for this use yet. Prices will appear here when sales open.
publicPricing.noOffers: No static IP offers are available right now. Check back later.
publicPricing.allSoldOut: All offers are out of stock
publicPricing.allSoldOutHint: Prices are shown for reference. Check back later for new stock.
publicPricing.search: Search country, city, or IP type
publicPricing.perIpTerm: per IP / {days} day | per IP / {days} days
publicPricing.staticNote: Stock changes often. Final price and stock are confirmed at checkout.
